title: Maturity and after

draft.title: Maturity and after
card: Maturity is the stage when sales level off. The business has built its market, and it is hard to win many more customers.
the business carries on at about the same size, with stable sales and profits.
the business renews itself with new products or by entering new markets, so sales can rise again.
sales and profits keep falling. If the fall continues, the business may close.
draft.remember: After maturity, a business can stay steady, renew itself, or decline.

a.q: What happens to sales when a business reaches maturity?
opts: They are at their lowest point
a.why: At maturity the market is largely won, so sales stop rising and level off. A sharp fall describes decline, which may come after maturity but is not the same as it.
a.clue: The business has built its market and growth has slowed.

b.q: Tom's surf shop in Byron Bay has sold about the same amount for years. He starts selling wetsuits online to customers across Australia. What is he doing?
opts: Renewing the business by entering a new market
Starting up in the establishment stage
b.why: Selling online to new customers is a new market, which is a way to renew the business and lift sales. A steady state would mean carrying on unchanged, so it does not fit.
b.clue: He is changing something to lift sales again.

b.best: Renewing the business by entering a new market

problems.detail: The clue 'He is changing something to lift sales again' points straight at renewal, and the question already says his sales have been flat for years and he starts selling online, so the answer is largely given away.

screen.summary: Question b's clue essentially gives away the renewal answer and should be reworded or removed. Question a and the card are accurate and match the syllabus.

b.best: Renewing the business by entering a new market
